findings.title: Constitutional architecture documents are stale or contradict each other (CR-01..CR-09)
findings.observed: Wrong ActorEngine path, six missing referenced documents, rules-authority model that contradicts ENGINE-ARCHITECTURE and the code, ActorEngine described as calculation-free while it orchestrates damage/condition/Force points, a 'no runtime patching' claim contradicted by 108 live patch sites, HouseRuleService method names that do not exist (B-HRL).
findings.proposedSolution: Owner rules on CR-03/CR-04 (rules-authority and ActorEngine role). Then correct the documents to reference Level A IDs instead of restating rules, and mark corrected sections with the decision date.
findings.alternatives: Freeze ARCHITECTURE.md as historical and make A-global-invariants.md the constitution.
findings.simplificationBenefit: Stops contributors (human or AI) following rules that are no longer true.

findings.title: Owner standing instructions are not committed; several APPROVED invariants have no versioned source

findings.title: 31 rules questions surfaced by the audit are not yet in the rules decision register (90 total; 59 already referenced)
findings.observed: Domain contracts record 90 DEFERRED_RULES_REVIEW items or rules-question findings; 59 cite an existing register ID, 31 do not. Investigators were not permitted to edit the register, and Phases 0-2 do not modify existing documents. The register is append-only and partly machine-parsed (tools/lib).
findings.proposedSolution: Review docs/audits/architecture-census/rules-questions-for-register.md and append the new items to the register (owner, or Claude on instruction). Nothing is decided by the audit.
findings.alternatives: Leave them in the audit ledger only (not recommended: CLAUDE.md requires one consolidated register).
findings.simplificationBenefit: One place for every open ruling.
